title: BMX (Mode)
description:
[h1]Games, scores and a trick bot for BMX.[/h1]
The gamemode for the [b]BMX[/b] addon: everything a BMX server plays. It is built on Sandbox, so the spawn menu, the physgun and the park-piece tool all still work.

[quote][b]Official server:[/b]  connect gmod.naliwajka.com:27015[/quote]

[h2]Requires[/h2]
[list]
[*]The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3814420080]BMX[/url] addon, version 1.1.0 or newer. Without it the gamemode loads, tells you so, and does nothing else.
[/list]

[h2]Games[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]SKATE.[/b] HORSE on bikes, for 2 to 8 riders. The setter lands a trick, and everyone else gets one try to land the same one. Miss it and you take a letter. Spell SKATE and you are out; the last rider standing wins.
[*][b]Trick Attack.[/b] Two minutes, everyone at once. Every trick and every combo bonus adds up, and the biggest total wins.
[*][b]Combo Mambo.[/b] One minute, and only your single best combo counts. Thirty small tricks lose to one big line.
[*]Start one with [b]bmx_game_start skate[/b], [b]attack[/b] or [b]mambo[/b]. Others join with [b]bmx_game_join[/b], and the host runs the start command again to begin.
[/list]

[h2]Scores[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Personal bests[/b] for every player, map and bike: biggest combo, biggest trick, longest grind, longest manual and biggest air.
[*][b]A leaderboard[/b] of the top ten in each: in a panel ([b]bmx_scores[/b]), and on a sign an admin can put up anywhere (Entities > BMX > BMX Leaderboard).
[*][b]Fair.[/b] Noclip, physgun-carried bikes and bots never make the table.
[/list]

[h2]The Trick Bot[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]A bot that rides.[/b] It rides the park on its own, lands bunny hops, wheelies, stoppies, flips, barrel rolls, 360s and grinds, and announces each one in chat. After a crash it gets back on.
[*][b]Smart about the park.[/b] On a map with a navmesh it plans its route, picks the ramps that actually work for it, and drops a kicker of its own where there are none.
[*][b]Plays SKATE with you.[/b] [b]bmx_game_start skate bot[/b] gives it a seat in the game.
[*][b]Always riding,[/b] if you want: with [b]bmx_bot_auto 1[/b] it rides whenever someone is on, and never takes the last free slot.
[*][b]Your own rider.[/b] Name it with [b]bmx_bot_name[/b], dress it with [b]bmx_bot_model[/b] (any player model you mount), and give it a scoreboard picture with [b]bmx_bot_avatar[/b]. No player model is included.
[/list]

[h2]Commands[/h2]
[table]
[tr][td]bmx_game_start skate|attack|mambo [bot][/td][td]Open a game (run it again to begin)[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]bmx_game_join / bmx_game_leave[/td][td]Join or leave the game[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]bmx_scores[/td][td]Open the scores[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]bmx_bot_spawn [stock|cruiser|mini][/td][td]Admin: a trick bot where you are looking[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]bmx_bot_trick <name>[/td][td]Admin: tell every bot which trick to do next[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]bmx_bot_remove[/td][td]Admin: remove every bot and its bikes[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]bmx_games_admin_only 1[/td][td]Server: only admins may start a game[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Server Owners[/h2]
Start with [b]+gamemode bmx[/b] (it shows as [b]BMX (Mode)[/b] in the gamemode list). It plays on any map and suggests itself for [b]petopia_bmx_fall[/b], the map made for it. Add the BMX addon to your server's collection so players get the bikes.
